BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE diagnostic_assessment_plan
    ADD CONSTRAINT uq_diagnostic_plan_delivery_binding
    UNIQUE (id, student_id, course_id, plan_revision, plan_digest);

CREATE TABLE diagnostic_assessment_reservation_receipt (
    plan_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL,
    attempt_id uuid NOT NULL,
    plan_revision integer NOT NULL,
    plan_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    reservation_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    reservation_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    received_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_diagnostic_reservation_plan FOREIGN KEY (plan_id, student_id, course_id, plan_revision, plan_digest)
        REFERENCES diagnostic_assessment_plan(id, student_id, course_id, plan_revision, plan_digest),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_reservation_binding CHECK (attempt_id=plan_id AND plan_revision >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_reservation_digests CHECK (plan_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND reservation_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_reservation_time CHECK (date_trunc('microseconds', received_at)=received_at),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_reservation_json CHECK (
        jsonb_typeof(reservation_json)='object' AND
        (reservation_json - 'schema' - 'id' - 'plan_id' - 'plan_revision' - 'plan_digest')='{}'::jsonb AND
        reservation_json->>'schema'='student-diagnostic-assessment-reservation.v1' AND
        reservation_json->>'id'=attempt_id::text AND reservation_json->>'plan_id'=plan_id::text AND
        reservation_json->>'plan_revision'=plan_revision::text AND reservation_json->>'plan_digest'=plan_digest
    )
);
COMMENT ON TABLE diagnostic_assessment_reservation_receipt IS 'Immutable Planner delivery proof of the Student-owned placement attempt reservation; no attempt state is copied.';

CREATE TABLE diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision (
    plan_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL,
    attempt_id uuid NOT NULL,
    plan_revision integer NOT NULL,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    course_content_revision varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    plan_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    result_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    correct integer NOT NULL,
    total integer NOT NULL,
    percent integer NOT NULL,
    band varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    band_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    route_code varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    route_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    result_completed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    decided_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    request_id uuid NOT NULL,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    decision_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    decision_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_diagnostic_placement_plan FOREIGN KEY (plan_id, student_id, course_id, plan_revision, plan_digest)
        REFERENCES diagnostic_assessment_plan(id, student_id, course_id, plan_revision, plan_digest),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_placement_binding CHECK (attempt_id=plan_id AND request_id=plan_id AND plan_revision >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_placement_aggregate CHECK (total BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND correct BETWEEN 0 AND total AND percent=correct*100/total AND band IN ('FOUNDATION','CORE','ADVANCED') AND band_policy_version='diagnostic-placement-band-v1' AND route_policy_version='diagnostic-placement-route-v1'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_placement_route CHECK ((band='FOUNDATION' AND route_code='START_FOUNDATION') OR (band='CORE' AND route_code='START_CORE') OR (band='ADVANCED' AND route_code='START_ADVANCED')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_placement_digests CHECK (course_content_revision ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND plan_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND result_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND decision_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_placement_times CHECK (date_trunc('microseconds', result_completed_at)=result_completed_at AND date_trunc('microseconds', decided_at)=decided_at),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_placement_json CHECK (
        jsonb_typeof(decision_json)='object' AND
        (decision_json - 'schema' - 'student_id' - 'course_id' - 'course_content_revision' - 'policy_version' - 'attempt_id' - 'plan_id' - 'plan_revision' - 'correct' - 'total' - 'percent' - 'band' - 'band_policy_version' - 'plan_digest' - 'result_digest' - 'result_completed_at' - 'route_code' - 'route_policy_version' - 'decided_at' - 'decision_digest')='{}'::jsonb AND
        decision_json->>'schema'='diagnostic-placement.v1' AND decision_json->>'student_id'=student_id::text AND decision_json->>'course_id'=course_id::text AND decision_json->>'course_content_revision'=course_content_revision AND decision_json->>'policy_version'=policy_version AND decision_json->>'attempt_id'=attempt_id::text AND decision_json->>'plan_id'=plan_id::text AND decision_json->>'plan_revision'=plan_revision::text AND decision_json->>'correct'=correct::text AND decision_json->>'total'=total::text AND decision_json->>'percent'=percent::text AND decision_json->>'band'=band AND decision_json->>'band_policy_version'=band_policy_version AND decision_json->>'plan_digest'=plan_digest AND decision_json->>'result_digest'=result_digest AND decision_json->>'route_code'=route_code AND decision_json->>'route_policy_version'=route_policy_version AND decision_json->>'decision_digest'=decision_digest AND
        CASE WHEN decision_json->>'result_completed_at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z$' THEN (decision_json->>'result_completed_at')::timestamptz=result_completed_at ELSE false END AND
        CASE WHEN decision_json->>'decided_at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z$' THEN (decision_json->>'decided_at')::timestamptz=decided_at ELSE false END
    )
);
COMMENT ON TABLE diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision IS 'Immutable aggregate-only placement decision receipt. It never stores answers, tasks, scorer state, mastery, paths, or evidence.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_assessment_delivery_receipts() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic assessment delivery receipts are immutable'; RETURN OLD; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_diagnostic_assessment_reservation_receipt BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON diagnostic_assessment_reservation_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_assessment_delivery_receipts();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_assessment_delivery_receipts();
COMMIT;
